whatMakesDifferent.question: What sets Sora 3 apart from other video generation platforms?
whatMakesDifferent.answer: Sora 3 excels at building extended narratives through Sora 3 Storyboard, maintaining character consistency throughout. While competitors limit output to brief clips, Sora 3 produces 25+ second stories ideal for brand campaigns, product launches, and social content. Sora 3 Storyboard gives you scene-by-scene control, preserves character identity, and delivers campaign-ready Sora 3 videos.

characterConsistency.question: How does Sora 3 maintain character consistency across scenes?
characterConsistency.answer: Sora 3 Storyboard preserves character appearance, wardrobe, and styling across every scene in your Sora 3 video. This Sora 3 capability is crucial for brand narratives, character-driven campaigns, and product demonstrations where consistent identity matters.

videosLongerThan10s.question: Can Sora 3 generate videos longer than 10 seconds?
videosLongerThan10s.answer: Yes. Sora 3 supports extended durations up to 25-30 seconds via Sora 3 Storyboard mode. This Sora 3 feature solves a key limitation, enabling full brand stories rather than fragmented clips. Sora 3 extended videos perform better in campaigns.

commercialUse.question: Are Sora 3 videos suitable for commercial advertising?
commercialUse.answer: Absolutely. Sora 3 generated content is fully licensed for commercial use, including paid ads, e-commerce videos, and social campaigns. You retain full rights to Sora 3 videos you create, subject to our usage guidelines.

watermarks.question: Do Sora 3 videos include watermarks?
watermarks.answer: No — all Sora 3 exports are completely watermark-free. Premium Sora 3 plans ensure no platform branding appears on downloads. Your Sora 3 videos export clean and ready for immediate campaign deployment. Note: This applies only to watermarks added by our platform, not third-party content.

officialModel.question: Does this platform use official Sora 3 technology?
officialModel.answer: We leverage advanced Sora 3 compatible technology to deliver professional results. This enables immediate Sora 3 video creation without waiting for official access.

25SecondVideos.question: Can I build 25-second Sora 3 videos?
25SecondVideos.answer: Yes — Sora 3 Storyboard enables 25-second Sora 3 multi-scene generation for complete brand narratives.

paymentSafe.question: If I make a payment, will my payment information be safe?
paymentSafe.answer: Absolutely. We use secure, trusted payment platforms and banks. Your payment is fully protected, and no personal information will ever be exposed or leaked.

hiddenCharges.question: Are there any hidden charges?
hiddenCharges.answer: No, the price displayed is the total amount you'll pay. There are no additional hidden fees. Annual plans save up to 50% compared to monthly billing.

faqCancelAnytime.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqCancelAnytime.answer: Yes! All plans can be canceled anytime. You'll retain access until the end of your billing period.

faqCreditsRollOver.question: Do unused credits roll over?
faqCreditsRollOver.answer: Subscription bucket resets each billing period and does not roll over. One-time add-on credits go to the flexible bucket and are not cleared by subscription resets.

faqRefundPolicy.question: What is sora3ai.io refund policy?
faqRefundPolicy.answer: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for all subscription plans. Contact support@sora3ai.io for refunds. For general inquiries and partnerships, contact team@sora3ai.io. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

faqContentRestrictions.question: Are there any video content restrictions?
faqContentRestrictions.answer: Our platform enforces strict content policies. We prohibit the generation of harmful, illegal, or inappropriate content. All generated videos undergo automatic screening to ensure policy compliance.

faqCreditsDeduction.question: Will credits be deducted if generation fails?
faqCreditsDeduction.answer: No. Credits are deducted atomically when a job starts, and automatically refunded if the generation fails or the upstream service returns an error. Refunds usually appear within a minute.

faqCancelSubscription.question: What happens to credits if I cancel my subscription?
faqCancelSubscription.answer: You can cancel anytime. Flexible (one-time) credits remain available. Subscription bucket follows your billing period and stops refreshing after the current period ends.

whatIsTool.question: What is the Image to Video tool?
whatIsTool.answer: Our AI Image to Video tool transforms your static images into fully animated videos using advanced AI. Simply upload your photo, illustration, or product image, and the AI brings it to life with natural motion, camera movements, and synchronized audio.

needExperience.question: Do I need any animation or video editing experience to use the Image to Video tool?

imageTypes.answer: The tool works with a wide variety of images including product photos, portraits, landscapes, illustrations, architectural photos, and design mockups. The AI analyzes the composition and generates motion that makes sense contextually for each image type.
